scenarios.name: strafe
scenarios.description: Both players circle their cover without firing. Pins plain movement, the speed cap and the countdown.

scenarios.name: crateHug
scenarios.description: Walks a body into every face and every inside corner it can reach, so the resolution order is pinned rather than assumed.

scenarios.name: verticality
scenarios.description: Jumping onto crates and crouching under the awning, which is where gravity, landing and the standing check all meet.

scenarios.name: duel
scenarios.description: Peek and shoot with a real rewind, so lag compensation and the history ring are pinned along with the ray.

scenarios.name: traded
scenarios.description: Both players fire on the same tick and both connect, so neither seat can be given a free trade by being resolved first.

scenarios.name: match
scenarios.description: Played all the way to the winning score, so scoring, respawning and the end of a match are all covered.
